name: duet
description: Two characters meet on a stage. Each is a network of its own (max, kid), sealed behind one answer; the cue is the line both hear; each character's answer is sent to the other, and the exchange ends where maxHops 3 stops it. Run it and the trace is a film.

neurons.description: The line that starts the scene: whoever holds the stage says it, and both characters hear it at once.
Max, dry and unhurried: a character is a network of its own (hear, feel, speak), and from the stage it is one body with one voice.
The kid, bright and quick to take offence: a second character network, the same three-neuron mind with its own lines.
